rule: One Part One short question, one separately selectable Part Two A/B/C task, or one Higher-Level option is a base task. Every finite printed route is expanded; a choose-N-of-M pool (N >= 2) is one card with the printed question verbatim (choice is not a route). Tasks needing a missing separate OS map/aerial source are census-held, never presented as answerable. Independently reviewed sittings (geography-reviewed-audit.json) instead take one base task per separately priced printed part, from their review ledgers.
